summary: Tested the admin panel and UPI plans feature on backend and frontend. Backend: new test_admin.py has 15 tests, all pass. The full suite is 61/61 (46 regression tests plus 15 new). Covered: admin auth gating (401/403/200), /api/me fields, public settings and plans (3 seeded), plans CRUD with offers and hidden plans, the user list with Clerk emails, deactivation (403 on PUT destinations, POST videos and POST streams/video, a WebSocket error message, GET still works, reactivation restores access), the self-deactivate 400, plan assign and remove, and the UPI payment flow (pending, duplicate UTR 409, approve, renewal adding duration_days, reject, deciding twice 404, mine list, and status filter). Admin settings PUT also works. UI checks done with Playwright: admin header shows nav-admin, all 5 admin tabs work, the users table (search, active switch, plan select, admin's own switch disabled), the offer toggle opening the edit dialog and showing the badge with ₹149 and ₹199 struck through, adding/editing/hiding/deleting a plan, the Settings save toast and its effect on the landing footer (support, mobile, wa.me link, email, social links, address), landing-pricing showing 3 cards when signed out, and the /plans flow (pay-dialog with a QR SVG and the UPI ID, submit disabled below 6 chars, submit then my-payments shows Pending, duplicate UTR shows an error toast). Admin approve/reject plus filters work, and the user's plan appears in the Users tab. A non-admin opening /admin goes to /dashboard, and a deactivated user sees the deactivated-banner.

minor.issue: The UTR min_length=6 check runs BEFORE .strip(). A UTR of 7 spaces is accepted and stored as '' (200), and '     A' is stored as 'A'. Because duplicates are checked against non-rejected payments, a stored '' UTR then gives 409 to any later blank UTR. Fix: strip in a Pydantic validator (or use constr(strip_whitespace=True, min_length=6)). Optionally restrict to alphanumeric.

ui_bugs.issue: The utr state persists after a submission or when the dialog is closed. Reopening any plan's dialog shows the previous UTR prefilled. Reset utr when the plan changes or the dialog closes.

issues: Plan cards aren't equal height (Pro Yearly with fewer features is shorter). In AdminPlans the wrapper div stops the card stretching, so add h-full.
Column widths shift when the 'till <date>' line appears under the plan select. Minor.

action_items: Fix UTR validation: strip whitespace before the length check (Pydantic validator) and reject blank UTRs.
Reset the PayDialog utr state on open/close.
Optional: equal-height plan cards (h-full) in AdminPlans.
Remove admin+clerk_test@example.com from ADMIN_EMAILS before production.
critical_code_review_comments: Deactivating a user calls streamer.stop(uid), which correctly kills live streams. The pytest deactivation test now uses a dedicated user (deact+clerk_test) so it can't kill user_a's streams in the parallel xdist worker.
require_active is only on the write/stream endpoints. A deactivated user can still DELETE videos and submit payments. That's probably intended, but confirm it.
list_users calls the Clerk API on every load (a full sync loop over 100-user pages). That's fine for small user counts but slow at scale; consider caching or a sync button.
get_profile raises an unhandled requests.HTTPError (500) if Clerk lookup fails for a first-time user. A 502/503 with a message would be cleaner (don't fall back to default values).
The payment duplicate check is find-then-insert with no unique index, so two concurrent submissions of the same UTR can both succeed. Add a partial unique index on utr for non-rejected payments.
Admin PUT /plans replaces the whole doc. The UI number input turned price 199 into 199.0 (a float). Harmless.

success_rate.backend: 100% (61/61); 1 minor validation bug found by extra edge test
success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows; 1 low UI bug
